notes: The Stronghold court prefab: every court-local number the client (src/stronghold/prefabs/stronghold.ts) and the co-op server (server/internal/sim/prefab.go) share.
Tile coordinates (u, v) are court-local ground tiles, 1 tile = 3 m; world px are the 2:1 projection (src/isometric.ts) plus court.origin.
server/internal/sim/stronghold.json is a byte-identical copy embedded in the Go binary; go test fails when they differ.
Props render in this order within equal layer and depth. layer is derived from (u, v): ground ids, rear rows (u or v <= 0) backdrop, front rows (u or v >= court.size) foreground, else world.
Perimeter scenery keeps a snow gap from the enclosure (scripts/verify-wall-clearance.mjs); drifts never lie under a wall line; no braziers at the front corner, the gateway covers them.
layout: legacy props appear only with ?buildings=all (the old layout); assetSet v1 loads from /modular-stronghold/ instead of /modular-stronghold/v2/.

gate.frontY is the walk-behind line under the arch and beyond the towers; gate.apron is the snow-to-paving fade in front of the gateway (edge y = edge - |x - gate.x| * slope); gate.footprintHeight gives the shadow height of the tower and door columns.

/world/map.json.name: Arkodia 01
notes: A square map of sizeTiles x sizeTiles ground tiles (1 tile = 3 m); map tiles (U, V) run 0..sizeTiles from the top corner.
Center to each edge is 5 minutes of walking at hero speed (net/movement.ts: 120 px/s across, 90 px/s up/down = 1.56 tiles/s along a tile edge): 300 s x 1.56 = 468 tiles.
Each prefab's anchor (court-local tile) is placed at its map tile; the Stronghold's court center (7.5, 7.5) sits on the map center.
chunkTiles is the planned chunk size for the chunk renderer (step b) and per-chunk collision (step c): 39 x 39 chunks, the Stronghold inside the center chunk.

terrain: ground height in meters is the highest feature containing a map tile, else 0. A plateau is a flat raised rectangle [u0, u1) x [v0, v1); a ramp slopes linearly from baseM to topM, rising toward its ascend side (-u, +u, -v or +v). A step that changes height by more than maxStepM is a cliff and is blocked; ramps are walkable. A hill uses an outline polygon and an integrated -v ramp from rampStartV to v1, clamped to topM above the crest. Heights draw at pxPerMeter screen px per meter.
